name: The Teacher's Law
source: Isao has just moved in with his aunt and cousin to commute to a new school. Suddenly, the government of Japan throws their household off balance with the Teacher's Law: in order to improve grades, teachers will have to have sex with their best students. Isao's aunt, a teacher, is dismayed by this news...
